targets.query:
phys = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics" and r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "link_speed_max")
  |> keep(columns: ["instance"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "instance")
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics" and r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "network_up" or r["_field"] == "link_speed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.instance, set: phys))
  |> group(columns: ["instance", "_field"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["instance"], mode: "by")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      up = exists r.network_up and r.network_up == 1.0
      sp = if exists r.link_speed then r.link_speed else 0.0
      label = if sp >= 1000.0 then string(v: sp / 1000.0) + "G"
              else if sp > 0.0 then string(v: int(v: sp)) + "M" else ""
      return { _time: r._time, instance: r.instance,
               _value: if not up then "DOWN" else if label == "" then "UP" else "UP " + label }
  })
  |> group(columns: ["instance"], mode: "by")
  |> yield(name: "link")

panels.description: New RX/TX errors per physical NIC in each interval (rx_errors, CRC, length, missed, overrun, FIFO, frame, tx_errors, carrier, aborted, collisions...). Green "OK" = no new errors, red "N errors" = N new errors in that interval. Drops are not counted here, see "NIC Drops" below.

targets.query:
phys = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics" and r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "link_speed_max")
  |> keep(columns: ["instance"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "instance")
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics" and r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^(rx_errors|rx_crc_errors|rx_length_errors|rx_missed_errors|rx_over_errors|rx_fifo_errors|rx_frame_errors|tx_errors|tx_carrier_errors|tx_aborted_errors|tx_fifo_errors|tx_heartbeat_errors|tx_window_errors|collisions)$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.instance, set: phys))
  |> group(columns: ["instance", "_field"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["instance"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, instance: r.instance,
      _value: if r._value == 0.0 then "OK"
              else string(v: int(v: r._value)) + (if r._value == 1.0 then " error" else " errors") }))
  |> group(columns: ["instance"], mode: "by")
  |> yield(name: "errors")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
    r._measurement == "system" and
    r.object == "nodes"
  )
  |> keyValues(keyColumns: ["host"])
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["host"])
  |> distinct(column: "host")
